title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes-2026-03-03
content:
Weekly release-train prep notes (scratchpad) - quick summary and action items

Date: 2026-03-03
Owner: Jamie Chen
Purpose: Sync before Fri go/no-go meeting. Quick readiness check and list of owners for last-mile items.

TOPLINE:
- Target launch window: Fri 2026-03-05 10:00 PT (soft launch + canary -> 100%)
- Current status: most infra + runtime changes merged; several last-minute bugs in canary path (REL-4567) blocking full rollout.
- Main risk: KV-cache regression observed under high-concurrency (see JIRA-REL-4599).

AGENDA (30m sync):
- Quick round: owners call status (5m)
- Blockers deep-dive: REL-4567, REL-4599 (10m)
- Go/no-go criteria check (5m)
- Action owners & deadlines (10m)

GO / NO-GO CRITERIA (check before meeting):
- Critical infra fixes merged and smoke-tested in canary (owner + evidence) -> REL-4567 fixed? (yes/no)
- End-to-end latency within SLO on canary at expected traffic (observability dashboard + traces)
- Error rate < 0.5% for 30m in canary (last 30m window)
- Rollback plan validated and tested (automated rollback + manual ops playbook)
- Key customer demos / contracts not blocked by breaking changes

CURRENT CHECKLIST (notes + owner + status):
- canary rollout plan v2 uploaded (Lina Martinez) -> uploaded, needs sign-off from SRE (status: in_review)
- REL-4567 - tokenization edge-case causing truncated responses in certain prompts (Ethan Patel) -> PR open, patch in review, smoke tests failing intermittently (status: in_progress)
- REL-4599 - KV cache race under high concurrency (Priya Singh) -> reproducer + load test created, mitigation in flight (status: in_progress)
- Observability: trace sampling bump + dashboard link (Jamie Chen) -> done, dashboard: CONSOLE -> /dashboards/release-canary (status: done)
notes:
Notes to self: - ask Lina for canary test run schedule, need 2 consecutive 30m windows with <0.5% error - remind SRE to have rollback playbook open in meeting - get explicit OK from product for demo customers if we go partial rollout

Open questions:
- Will infra autoscaling be sufficient for expected spike during canary? (need SRE numbers)
- Is there an alternative config for KV cache persistence that avoids the race without full refactor?

Follow-ups / action items:
- Ethan: finish REL-4567 patch + resolve intermittent smoke test flakes. Deadline: 2026-03-04 18:00 PT. Escalate to eng leads if not green by EOD.
- Priya: finish mitigation for REL-4599 + run 2x 30m load windows in canary. Provide logs and flamegraphs. Deadline: 2026-03-04 20:00 PT.
- Lina: finalize canary rollout doc, include traffic % steps and monitoring checklist, share by 2026-03-04 12:00 PT.
- SRE (oncall SLO): confirm autoscaling thresholds and rollback trigger thresholds. Owner: Marcus (cc Lina). Deadline: 2026-03-04 16:00 PT.
- Product: confirm go/no-go conditions for demo customers (owner: Priya to sync with Arjun). Deadline: 2026-03-04 17:00 PT.

Runbook / rollback notes (short):
- Automated rollback: disable canary traffic via deployment manager (runbook link in Confluence).
- Manual: redeploy previous image tag to canary nodes, drain instances, notify customers via status page.
- Post-rollback: create postmortem doc and schedule 1-hour blameless review (owner: Jamie).

Quick test evidence checklist to collect before go/no-go:
- Can we get 2x 30m windows with error <0.5%? (yes/no) -> attach dashboard snapshots
- End-to-end p99 latency < 800ms (chat gen) under canary load -> attach traces
- Smoke test matrix pass (tokenization, streaming, function-calls) -> list run ids

Meeting prep: what I want to ask in the sync:
- Lina: confirm explicit canary % steps and rollback thresholds
- Ethan: quick demo of failing prompt that triggered REL-4567 + status of fix
- Priya: summary of load test results and mitigation approach for KV cache race
- SRE: are scaling thresholds likely to kick-in under expected canary volume?

Misc scratchpad / talking points (informal):
- If REL-4567 still flaky, consider short delay to push fix into next minor patch rather than risk rollback complexity. Need product buy-in.
- Keep comms concise: status page + Slack #release-train update if we flip go/no-go
- Reminder: legal asked for audit logs confirmation for Private customers — confirm none of our rollout changes affect logging (chatted w/ security, they said ok but want note)

Attachments to add later:
- link to canary dashboard snapshots (placeholder)
- load test flamegraphs
- PR links + CI links

Status log (small):
- 2026-02-28: initial kick-off, scope defined, owners assigned
- 2026-03-01: infra changes merged in staging
- 2026-03-02: canary rollout started, initial flaky behavior observed
- 2026-03-03: action items assigned (Ethan/Priya/Lina), prep for go/no-go

End of notes.
summary: Prep notes and action list for release-train weekly go/no-go sync. Draft status; owners assigned for last-mile fixes.
